blocks.tamil_translation: fire of Jahannam,” Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Praying four rak'ahs before Zuhr is Sunnah Mu'akkadah; of the four rak'ahs prayed after Zuhr, two rak'ahs are Sunnah Mu'akkadah and two rak'ahs are Nafl
(Nasa'i)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ ﵂ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَامِنْ عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَتَمَسَّ وَجْهَهُ النَّارُ أَبَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ .
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب الاختلاف علي اسماعيل بن ابي خالد،رقم:١٨١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whichever believing servant prays four rak'ahs after Zuhr, if Allah wills, the fire of Jahannam will never touch him,” Hazrat Umm Habibah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعاً بَعْدَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَقَالَ: إِنَّهَا سَاعَةٌ تُفْتَحُ فِيهَا أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَأُحِبُّ أَنْ يَصْعَدَ لِي فِيهَا عَمَلٌ صَالِحٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث عبدالله بن السائب حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاء في الصلاة عندالزوال رقم:٤٧٨. الجامع الصحيح وهو سنن الترمذي
blocks.tamil_translation: “Rasulullah ﷺ used to pray four rak'ahs after Zawal (the sun passing its zenith) before Zuhr. And he would say, “At this time the doors of the heavens are opened, so I love that some good deed of mine should go up towards the heavens,”” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Sa'ib (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The four rak'ahs before Zuhr are the four rak'ahs that are Sunnah Mu'akkadah. Also, “the four rak'ahs after Zawal are four rak'ahs apart from the Sunnah Mu'akkadah of Zuhr,” some of the Ulama
